psychological_meaning: Turquoise represents sophistication, tranquility, and wisdom. It balances the serenity of blue with the growth of green, fostering emotional balance and a sense of calm. This color is often associated with open communication and clarity of thought, promoting self-expression and creative energy. It is a color of healing and understanding, inspiring empathy and compassion.

real_world_examples.title: Turquoise Waters of the Caribbean
real_world_examples.description: The crystal-clear turquoise waters of the Caribbean Sea are a stunning example of this color in nature, inspiring feelings of peace and relaxation.

real_world_examples.title: Tiffany & Co.'s Iconic Blue Boxes
real_world_examples.description: Tiffany & Co.'s signature blue boxes, often referred to as 'Tiffany Blue' (a shade similar to turquoise), are synonymous with luxury and elegance.

how_to_pair: Pair with coral for a vibrant, contrasting look.
Combine with neutrals like white or gray for a clean, modern aesthetic.
Use with shades of blue and green for a harmonious, aquatic feel.
Add gold accents for a touch of luxury.
